model.name: Gen37
model.selection: highest legal logit; lowest action index breaks exact ties
model.probability_meaning: Softmax of legal network logits at temperature 1. Preference, not win probability. Selection is deterministic.

method.response: Within-decision centered raw legal settlement logit.
method.feature_centering: Subtract the mean over all legal candidates in the same decision from each predictor and target.
method.weights: Average candidate squared errors within each decision, then average decisions equally. Each stage has one decision per board.
method.objective: mean_training_boards(mean_legal_candidates((centered_y - sum_j standardized_beta_j * centered_x_j / training_rms_j)^2)) + 0.001 * sum_j standardized_beta_j^2
method.scale: training_rms_j = sqrt(mean_training_boards(mean_legal_candidates(centered_x_j^2))). No target scaling and no intercept.
method.raw_coefficient: standardized_beta_j / training_rms_j: relative-logit units per one raw feature unit, conditional on other predictors in this model.
method.standardized_coefficient: Relative-logit units per one training RMS of within-decision feature variation. The target itself is not standardized.
method.omissions: Training-constant features and exact dependencies on earlier ordered columns are omitted. Their exported coefficients are null, not estimates of zero effect. Rank tolerance 1e-9 on standardized covariance.
method.single_resource_r2: One predictor, that resource's local production pips, with the same centering and split. It does not isolate conditional resource value.
method.leave_one_resource_out: Refit the five-resource-only model after removing exactly one resource. Delta R² = full five-resource R² minus reduced-model R² on the same 200 held-out boards. This is incremental prediction contribution, not a causal effect or a fraction of choice probability.

train_coefficient_bootstrap.method: Sample 800 training boards with replacement. Recompute within-training RMS scales and refit the same fixed-ridge five-resource model using weighted board-level sufficient statistics. Percentile 2.5% and 97.5% bounds.
train_coefficient_bootstrap.conditioning: Conditional on the frozen checkpoint, generated greedy-prefix population, fixed original train/test split, chosen feature definitions, fixed ridge penalty and regression pipeline. It captures training-board sampling variability, not uncertainty in policy training, causal identification, feature/model selection or generalization to other rules or human play.

test_metric_bootstrap.method: Resample the 200 held-out boards jointly for compared models. Models stay fixed. Percentile intervals do not include training-fit variability.

method.no_inference: All inputs are cached. No game generation, neural policy inference, search, policy training or full-game evaluation is performed.

notation.P_r: Candidate settlement production pips for resource r.
notation.O_r: Existing own settlement production pips for resource r before this decision.
notation.pip: pip(n)=6-|7-n| for a producing number; desert contributes zero. Expected cards per roll = pips/36.
notation.c_n: Number of producing hex incidences at the candidate with number n.
notation.o_n: Number of producing hex incidences across existing own settlements with number n; count each settlement.
notation.q_n: Exact two-dice probability of outcome n, including 7 with probability 6/36.
notation.d: Unweighted shortest graph-edge distance; not construction cost or a legal/affordable route.

feature_dictionary.name: total_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Expected production numerator: cards per roll = pips / 36, ignoring robber and bank shortage.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_r P_r(v)

feature_dictionary.name: wood_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Candidate settlement production pips for wood.
feature_dictionary.formula: P_wood(v): sum of pip(number) over touching wood hexes

feature_dictionary.name: brick_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Candidate settlement production pips for brick.
feature_dictionary.formula: P_brick(v): sum of pip(number) over touching brick hexes

feature_dictionary.name: sheep_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Candidate settlement production pips for sheep.
feature_dictionary.formula: P_sheep(v): sum of pip(number) over touching sheep hexes

feature_dictionary.name: wheat_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Candidate settlement production pips for wheat.
feature_dictionary.formula: P_wheat(v): sum of pip(number) over touching wheat hexes

feature_dictionary.name: ore_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Candidate settlement production pips for ore.
feature_dictionary.formula: P_ore(v): sum of pip(number) over touching ore hexes

feature_dictionary.name: adjacent_hexes
feature_dictionary.definition: Number of touching hexes, including desert; coastal/interior control.
feature_dictionary.formula: count of all hexes touching v, including desert

feature_dictionary.name: local_resource_count
feature_dictionary.definition: Distinct producing resources touched by this candidate.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_r 1[P_r(v) > 0]

feature_dictionary.name: new_resource_types
feature_dictionary.definition: Resources added that existing own settlements do not produce.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_r 1[P_r(v) > 0 and O_r = 0]

feature_dictionary.name: new_resource_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Candidate pips in resources missing from existing own settlements.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_r P_r(v) * 1[O_r = 0]

feature_dictionary.name: combined_resource_count
feature_dictionary.definition: Distinct resources after adding this candidate to existing own settlements.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_r 1[C_r(v) > 0]

feature_dictionary.name: all_five_covered
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the combined own portfolio produces all five resources.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[all five C_r(v) > 0]

feature_dictionary.name: combined_total_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Sum of candidate and existing own settlement pips, counting each settlement.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_r C_r(v)

feature_dictionary.name: combined_concentration_hhi
feature_dictionary.definition: Sum of squared resource shares; 1 means one-resource concentration, 0.2 means five equal shares.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_r (C_r(v) / sum_s C_s(v))^2; zero if total is zero
feature_dictionary.coefficient_unit: relative logit per dimensionless resource-share concentration

feature_dictionary.name: combined_resource_entropy
feature_dictionary.definition: Natural-log entropy of combined resource pip shares; zero when concentrated in one resource.
feature_dictionary.formula: -sum_r q_r log(q_r), q_r = C_r / sum_s C_s; zero shares contribute zero

feature_dictionary.name: combined_wood_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for wood.
feature_dictionary.formula: C_wood(v) = P_wood(v) + O_wood

feature_dictionary.name: wood_starting_cards
feature_dictionary.definition: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
feature_dictionary.formula: count of touching producing wood hexes if this is the actor's second settlement; otherwise 0

feature_dictionary.name: combined_brick_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for brick.
feature_dictionary.formula: C_brick(v) = P_brick(v) + O_brick

feature_dictionary.name: brick_starting_cards

feature_dictionary.formula: C_sheep(v) = P_sheep(v) + O_sheep

feature_dictionary.formula: count of touching producing ore hexes if this is the actor's second settlement; otherwise 0

feature_dictionary.name: direct_port
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the candidate touches any port.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[v is a corner served by any port]

feature_dictionary.name: generic_port
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the candidate touches a generic 3:1 port.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[v is a corner served by a generic 3:1 port]

feature_dictionary.name: wood_port
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the candidate touches the wood 2:1 port.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[v is served by the specialized wood 2:1 port]

feature_dictionary.name: brick_port
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the candidate touches the brick 2:1 port.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[v is served by the specialized brick 2:1 port]

feature_dictionary.name: sheep_port
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the candidate touches the sheep 2:1 port.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[v is served by the specialized sheep 2:1 port]

feature_dictionary.name: wheat_port
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the candidate touches the wheat 2:1 port.

feature_dictionary.name: ore_port
feature_dictionary.definition: One if the candidate touches the ore 2:1 port.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[v is served by the specialized ore 2:1 port]

feature_dictionary.name: port_matching_combined_pips
feature_dictionary.definition: Combined own pips in the specialized port resource, zero unless this candidate directly touches that port.
feature_dictionary.formula: C_r(v) if v directly touches the specialized r port; otherwise 0

feature_dictionary.name: nearest_port_distance
feature_dictionary.definition: Shortest geometric edge distance from this candidate to any port corner; ignores ownership, road direction, cost and blocking.
feature_dictionary.formula: min_{u served by any port} d(v,u)

feature_dictionary.name: nearest_generic_port_distance
feature_dictionary.definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to any generic 3:1 port corner.
feature_dictionary.formula: min_{u served by a generic port} d(v,u)

feature_dictionary.name: wood_port_distance
feature_dictionary.definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the wood port.
feature_dictionary.formula: min_{u served by wood port} d(v,u)

feature_dictionary.name: brick_port_distance
feature_dictionary.definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the brick port.
feature_dictionary.formula: min_{u served by brick port} d(v,u)

feature_dictionary.name: sheep_port_distance
feature_dictionary.definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the sheep port.
feature_dictionary.formula: min_{u served by sheep port} d(v,u)

feature_dictionary.name: wheat_port_distance
feature_dictionary.definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the wheat port.
feature_dictionary.formula: min_{u served by wheat port} d(v,u)

feature_dictionary.name: ore_port_distance
feature_dictionary.definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the ore port.
feature_dictionary.formula: min_{u served by ore port} d(v,u)

feature_dictionary.name: matched_port_potential
feature_dictionary.definition: Maximum over resources of combined resource pips / (1 + geometric port distance); already owned ports use distance zero. A descriptive interaction, not a trade-value model.
feature_dictionary.formula: max_r C_r(v) / (1 + D_r(v)); D_r = geometric distance to resource-r port, or 0 if already owned
feature_dictionary.coefficient_unit: relative logit per production pips per (1 + edge distance)

feature_dictionary.name: unique_local_numbers
feature_dictionary.definition: Distinct dice outcomes producing cards at this candidate.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_n 1[c_n(v) > 0]
feature_dictionary.coefficient_unit: relative logit per distinct producing dice outcomes

feature_dictionary.name: unique_combined_numbers
feature_dictionary.definition: Distinct dice outcomes producing cards for the combined own portfolio.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_n 1[c_n(v) + o_n > 0]
feature_dictionary.coefficient_unit: relative logit per distinct producing dice outcomes

feature_dictionary.name: pips_overlapping_owned_numbers
feature_dictionary.definition: Candidate pips on number outcomes already collected by an own settlement.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_n c_n(v) * 1[o_n > 0] * pip(n)

feature_dictionary.name: combined_production_variance
feature_dictionary.definition: Variance in total cards per roll, counting shared numbers exactly; ignores robber and bank shortage.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_n q_n (c_n(v)+o_n)^2 - (sum_n q_n (c_n(v)+o_n))^2
feature_dictionary.coefficient_unit: relative logit per cards squared per dice roll

feature_dictionary.name: combined_zero_production_probability
feature_dictionary.definition: Probability of collecting zero cards on a dice roll, including seven; ignores robber and bank shortage.
feature_dictionary.formula: sum_n q_n * 1[c_n(v)+o_n = 0], including n=7

feature_dictionary.name: best_expansion_pips_two_roads
feature_dictionary.definition: Highest-pip currently distance-rule-open corner exactly two geometric edges away; excludes cost, direction and competition.
feature_dictionary.formula: max total_pips(u) over d(v,u)=2 and u currently open by the settlement distance rule; 0 if no such u

feature_dictionary.name: opponent_proximity
feature_dictionary.definition: 1/(1 + closest opponent settlement edge distance); zero if no opponent settlement yet.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1 / (1 + min_{u opponent settlement} d(v,u)); 0 if none
feature_dictionary.coefficient_unit: relative logit per inverse (1 + graph edges)

feature_dictionary.name: own_proximity
feature_dictionary.definition: 1/(1 + closest own settlement edge distance); zero if no own settlement yet.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1 / (1 + min_{u own settlement} d(v,u)); 0 if none
feature_dictionary.coefficient_unit: relative logit per inverse (1 + graph edges)

feature_dictionary.name: desert_adjacency
feature_dictionary.definition: One if this candidate touches the desert.
feature_dictionary.formula: 1[any hex touching v is desert]

tests: Original 20 model fits, R² intervals, omission sets and top-choice agreements reproduced.
All 20 standalone resource R² values reproduced.
All sufficient-statistic MSE values independently checked against per-candidate residuals.
First bootstrap draw in each stage checked against directly reweighted candidate rows.
All resampled five-resource designs full rank; same whole-board bootstrap multiplicities used across stages.
All original input files retain their pre-run SHA-256 hashes.

caveats: All later positions depend on earlier greedy network choices.
High R² over all legal scores need not imply accurate prediction of the top choice.
Resource-alone R², conditional slopes and leave-one-out ΔR² answer different questions; neither R² nor coefficients are causal resource importance.
Number features include nonlinear functions of production. In first settlements, variance can partly encode curvature in total production rather than a separable preference for risk.
Raw coefficients with unlike units should not be ranked by magnitude. Standardized coefficients still depend on model specification and correlated predictors.
Bootstrap bounds are exploratory descriptive intervals conditional on this specified analysis; multiple comparisons are not adjusted.
